versions.commit_message_first_line: Remove incorrect per-file subject attribution from sourcedata_provenance.json (#5)

pulls.title:
Remove incorrect per-file subject attribution from sourcedata_provenance.json

Every file was stamped with the dataset's LAST subject (an attribution
loop bug in the enrichment tooling). For this dataset data_path()
returns the same whole-dataset location for every subject, so per-file
subject attribution is not derivable from evidence. Without subject
fields, consumers correctly fall back to fetching the full tree. (v1.0.6)
pulls.author: bruAristimunha
